review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: As a family-owned company founded in 1892 and headquartered in Vienna, Kapsch can look back on 130 years of experience with the future. Conduct system security audits and support compliance initiatives to ensure adherence to organizational and customer requirements. Support multiple customers, projects, and environments, balancing operational priorities and project requirements. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Active Directory, PowerShell, SharePoint, and Microsoft Office Suite. Ability to develop technical expertise and provide training and guidance to end users and technical staff on new technologies and processes.
